channel.title: Hashbeam
channel.description: Hashbeam reports crypto news: protocol upgrades, network security, exchanges, stablecoins, regulation and market structure across blockchains and tokens.

item.title: Fluidkey Ties $1.6M Theft to Unpatched SigNoz Flaws
item.description: Fluidkey says flaws in its self-hosted SigNoz logger exposed session tokens used to stage $1.6 million in transfers from 52 accounts across six chains.

item.title: Hyundai Card tests AI treasury agents on Kinexys
item.description: Hyundai Card and Kinexys tested an AI treasury agent that requested FX to top up a euro account, with bank-side identity, mandate and control checks.

item.title: How to recover tokens sent to a contract by mistake
item.description: Sent tokens to a token contract address by mistake can they be recovered? Recovery needs a rescue function or an upgrade admin willing and able to act.

item.title: Why Won’t My Wallet Connect to a Bridge Website on Ethereum?
item.description: Why wont my wallet connect to a bridge website? A locked or competing extension, wrong network, or mismatched wallet usually explains the failed connection.

item.title: Blind signing in crypto: what your wallet cannot decode
item.description: What is blind signing in crypto? It is approving data your wallet cannot explain, so you cannot see the action before signing.

item.title: How to show Bitcoin bridge status from deposit to mint
item.description: Learn how to show Bitcoin bridge status in a dApp: track deposit confirmations, bridge processing and the destination mint before marking a transfer complete.

item.title: A TRON DEX keeps the swap logic, changes the rails
item.description: Using a TRON DEX after Uniswap changes your wallet, fee resources and token network; pool pricing, approvals, slippage and price impact stay familiar.

item.title: How to test an Ethereum RPC endpoint with curl and identify its chain
item.description: Test an Ethereum RPC endpoint with curl by sending a JSON-RPC POST. Read eth_chainId for the returned chain ID, then use eth_blockNumber as a second check.

item.title: Cross-chain swaps vs bridges: where settlement differs
item.description: Cross-chain swap vs bridge difference: a bridge moves the same asset; a cross-chain swap changes the asset and chain, with different trust and failure paths.

item.title: Variational raises $110 million at $1.5 billion valuation
item.description: Variational raised $110 million at a $1.5 billion valuation to expand Omni markets, raise position limits and move toward round-the-clock swaps trading.

item.title: ETH to Sui: Suibridge vs Wormhole by Source and Coin Type
item.description: For ETH on Ethereum mainnet, Suibridge is the usual route to Sui when your destination app accepts its ETH coin type. Sui validators secure the bridge…

item.title: Run your own Ethereum node vs an RPC provider for your workload
item.description: Run your own Ethereum node vs use an RPC provider: use a provider for wallets and light apps; run a node when privacy, heavy querying or control matters.

item.title: Native USDC vs USDC.e: Which Should You Hold?
item.description: Native USDC vs bridged USDC.e: native USDC is issued by Circle on that chain; USDC.e is backed by USDC locked on Ethereum and adds bridge risk.

item.title: Aave App adds TRON USDT deposits in Android early access
item.description: Aave opened Android early access and added TRON USDT deposits, giving savers a new funding route while vault accounting and listed withdrawals remain on Arbitrum.

item.title: How to Claim an Arbitrum Withdrawal on Ethereum When Ready
item.description: How to claim an Arbitrum bridge withdrawal on Ethereum: wait until the bridge marks it claimable, submit the Ethereum transaction, and receive funds at the set recipient.

item.title: How to find the GnosisScan receipt after a bridge
item.description: How to find the destination transaction on GnosisScan after bridging: use Bridge Explorer to open the Gnosis receipt and verify the token arrival and recipient.

item.title: US Wins Court Authority Over $1.2B in Binance Theft Crypto
item.description: The Justice Department says a court authorized seizure or restraint of over $1.2 billion from more than $2.7 billion frozen after Binance’s October theft.

item.title: What should I check before bridging Bitcoin to Ethereum?
item.description: Use this checklist for integrating Bitcoin to Ethereum bridging in a dApp: verify minting, redemption, token decimals, confirmation waits, addresses and shutdown plans.

item.title: US wins authority to seize $1.2 billion from Binance theft
item.description: The Justice Department says courts authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion in Binance theft proceeds, part of $2.7 billion frozen so far.

item.title: How to See What an Ethereum MEV-Boost Relay Sees Before Signing
item.description: What can an Ethereum MEV-Boost relay see? It sees submitted payload transactions and their order, while the validator signs a blinded header first.
